# CANDIDATE: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_WITH_STRUCTURE_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** wiring_proposal
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Applying the structure veto (which blocks P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend) to the weekly DTE signal (1DTE/2DTE vwap_continuation) will further improve edge by removing losing trades that go against the short-term trend, building on the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate's demonstrated OOS exp/tr monotonicity ($36.34 → $59.02 → $66.13) while preserving its anchor-no-regression property on J's PUT winner days.

## Mechanism

Entry: Same as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE — use the `vwap_continuation` signal (first ≤10:30-ET bar continuing the direction of the first 3 RTH closes relative to session VWAP) but at 1DTE or 2DTE expiry (ITM-2 strike, -8%/+30% exit).  
Filter: Add `structure_veto_enabled` gate — block PUT entries when 5m same-day trend is uptrend, block CALL entries when 5m same-day trend is downtrend (using `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend`).  
Exit: Identical to WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE — -8% stop, +30% TP1 (sell 2/3), runner trails chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, 15% trail), time stop 15:50 ET.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ≈14% headline P&L (per risk-rules.md position sizing table).  
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest would use 16-month OPRA cache (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) with walk-forward OOS split (12mo train, 4.3mo test); overfit risk mitigated by multiplicative OP-16 gate (edge_capture × aggregate_sharpe) and concentration disclosure.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (requires Stage-1 backtest to compute WF ratio and OOS exp/tr).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (requires Stage-1 backtest using cached real OPRA bids/asks/slippage model on top 3 J days).  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: Potential large loss if structure veto fails during strong trend reversals (e.g., 5/07 call loser day).  
   - Max drawdown: Estimated < -$2,500 based on WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE's maxDD (-$2,273) plus veto-induced whipsaws.  
   - Blow-up scenario: VIX spike >30 causing structure misclassification + weekly DTE theta decay (mitigated by -8% stop).  
6. **Concentration:** NEEDS-CONCENTRATION-DISCLOSURE (requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L; WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE had drop-top3 near full mean ($45-$59) suggesting low concentration).
